newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai government bank plans 6-bln baht bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Thai government bank plans 6-bln baht bond issue.

text.p: Thailand's Government Housing Bank plans to issue two new tranches of eight to 10 year bonds worth a total of six billion baht in March, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.

Senior finance ministry official Nibhat Bhukkanasut told reporters the bonds are expected to carry an annual coupon of about 9.45 percent, about the same rate offered by the tranche floated on Monday.
The finance ministry will mandate the issue's underwriters and arrangers by March 2, he said.
Proceeds from the bond issue will be used by the Government Housing Bank for relending to its clients.
